plan: meetfar (game/probe/unit_probe.py plans counterfar - part 1 - and intercept - part 2)

what.counterfar: fearless Skaven clanrats_0 (160, no shields, ordered 30 m wide) start 200 m (front to front) off our fearless Empire spearmen_0 / swordsmen (30 m) and attack them at a run ('run') or a walk ('walk'); ours hold (never ordered) or attack at a run once the centres are within X m + the half depths (cX, X = 35 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150; order_gap_m: the measured centres less the half depths at the order); 'stand': the clanrats never ordered, ours attack at the go from X = 45 / 100 / 160 m. Shares of each side's starting health lost 0-3 / 0-10 / 0-30 / 0-60 s from the sample before the first melee flag; trade = theirs - ours.
what.intercept: our A (Empire spearmen_0, 30 m) and B (Empire swordsmen, 30 m) side by side, 48 m centre to centre, facing the enemy; fearless clanrats_0 E1 200 m (front to front) in front of A and E2 60 m behind E1 and 24 m toward B's side (centres; chosen so that E2 reaches A ~16 s after E1 without crossing E1's path: tmp/meetfar/e2_choice.log), both attack A at a run at the go; A never ordered; A and B keep their morale. B: hold - never ordered; far - attacks E2 at a run once the centres less the half depths are 120 m; near - at 35 m, or at E2's closest approach (the distance grew 2 m past its least, or E2 in melee: a_go 'closest'); pinE1 - attacks E1 10 s after E1's first melee flag; pinE2 - attacks E2 10 s after E2's first melee flag. c0 = the lane's first melee flag (any unit). Health lost from the sample before c0; own = A + B, en = E1 + E2, shares of the side's starting health; trade = en - own. B on the right (+x) in odd battles, on the left in even ones; one lane of each kind a battle.

stats: summary: [mean, standard error of the mean, n] over lanes; answers: differences of the trade, game paired by battle (each battle holds one lane of each kind), twin as independent means

intercept: does far beat near and hold by the lane's trade at 60 / 120 s
the order of the five variants by the trade at 60 / 120 s
counterfar: is the trade over 60 s flat across the order's gap 35-150 m (the twin: yes), for spearmen and swordsmen, clanrats at a run and at a walk
attacking a standing enemy from 45 / 100 / 160 m

pred_sim: the twin (game.probe.charge_probe.sim_lanes) on the plan's own places, before any game battle: intercept 8 copies of each of 10 lanes (both sides of B), counterfar 4 copies of each of 30 lanes; simulator at commit ef1681b (no simulator change; the probe's own files changed). Commands: bash ops/dock.sh game.probe.unit_probe --intercept layout --copies 8; ... --counterfar layout --copies 4
sim: twin = sim_lanes on the game's recorded starts (intercept 8 copies a lane, counterfar 4), simulator at commit ef1681b; re-run: python -m game.probe.unit_probe --<plan> game <runs> --sim --copies N (container: bash ops/dock.sh ...)
